# Firstlight UI

> Current public documentation for firstlightui/nativephp.

- Website: https://firstlightui.dev
- Repository: https://github.com/firstlightui/nativephp
- Package: firstlightui/nativephp

## Documentation

- [Install Firstlight UI](https://firstlightui.dev/getting-started/installation): Install Firstlight, register its NativePHP plugin, and rebuild the native projects.
- [Add your first Firstlight component](https://firstlightui.dev/getting-started/first-component): Add a Segmented control whose selected value is managed by PHP.
- [Theme Firstlight components](https://firstlightui.dev/getting-started/theming): Configure the semantic NativePHP theme tokens that Firstlight components inherit on iOS and Android.
- [SuperNative components](https://firstlightui.dev/concepts/supernative-components): How Firstlight turns shared EDGE markup into genuine iOS and Android controls.
- [Server-authoritative state](https://firstlightui.dev/concepts/server-authoritative-state): How Firstlight reconciles immediate native interaction with values accepted and published by PHP.
- [Pill Group](https://firstlightui.dev/components/pill-group): Public API, selection modes, state timing, accessibility, validation, and platform behaviour for Firstlight Pill Group.
- [Segmented](https://firstlightui.dev/components/segmented): Public API, state, accessibility, validation, compatibility, and visual evidence for Firstlight Segmented.
- [Status Label](https://firstlightui.dev/components/status-label): Public API, tones, accessibility, validation, compatibility, and visual evidence for Firstlight Status Label.
- [Text Field](https://firstlightui.dev/components/text-field): Public API, focused editing, semantic input hints, icons, accessibility, and platform behaviour for Firstlight Text Field.
- [Compatibility](https://firstlightui.dev/reference/compatibility): Current language, framework, platform, and Swift package requirements for Firstlight UI.
